setup.text: Toby leans a river stone against the nearest flour sack. The stone rises a hand's breadth and hangs heavy against the grain.

option_a.text:
The player asks, "Is that one short?"

Toby nods, adjusting his grip on the sack. "Hangs low. That's full."

option_b.text: The player sets the stone against the second sack. The rock holds steady, hanging perfectly level with the first.

option_c.text: The player sets the stone against the brick oven floor. The stone simply drops, finding no purchase.
